question: Jayanthi Kumaresh is one of the foremost exponents of _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**veena.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jayanthi Kumaresh** is one of the foremost exponents of **Veena.**
 
• Veena is a** stringed instrument** that has been played in India for centuries.
 
• It is considered to be one of the **oldest musical instruments** in the world.
 
• Jayanthi Kumaresh has been playing the Veena since the** age of three **and has established herself as one of the leading performers of the instrument.
 
• She has won **numerous awards and accolades** for her performances and has also collaborated with musicians from different parts of the world.
 
• Jayanthi Kumaresh has also been actively involved in promoting the Veena and has **conducted workshops and masterclasses** to teach the instrument to a wider audience.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Santoor **is a **hammered dulcimer** that is popular in the **Kashmiri and Persian **music traditions.
 
• **Tabla** is a pair of drums that are commonly used in **Hindustani classical music.**
 
 
• It consists of a small drum called the** dayan** and a larger drum called the **bayan.**
 
 
 
• **Sitar** is a plucked stringed instrument that is used in **Hindustani classical music.**
 
 
• It has a** long neck and a pear-shaped body **with a gourd resonator.
